school: J. F. Drake State Community and Technical College
document_title: J.F. Drake State Community and Technical College Financial Statements, September 30, 2024
pages: FY2024 report: 4-6 (auditor's report); 13-14 (Statement of Net Position); 15 (SRECNP); 24-26 (deposits and investments note). FY2025 report (https://www.accs.edu/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/DRAKE-FY25.pdf): 5-7 (auditor's report dated January 15, 2026); 26 (college statement of net position); 28 (Foundation statement of financial position); 64 and 68 (Foundation notes)
quotes: COLLEGE, FY2024 audit dated January 14, 2025, p.13, Non-Current Assets at September 30, 2024: 'Endowment Investments 209,743'. p.15: 'Endowment Income 32,486'. p.14: 'Restricted - Nonexpendable Scholarships -'. The FY2024 report does not present or mention the Foundation. FOUNDATION, FY2025 audit dated January 15, 2026 (Drake State Technical College Foundation, Inc., presented as of December 31, 2024), p.68: 'Endowment net assets at December 31, 2023 $38,334'; 'Contributions 225,000'; 'Interest and Dividends 3,625'; 'Investment return 5,259'; 'Administrative fees (484)'; 'Endowment net assets at December 31, 2024 $271,734'. p.64: '$271,734 are endowments, restricted for use'. p.28: 'Communtiy Foundation Investments 271,734' [spelling as printed]. FY2025 college figure for reference, p.26: 'Endowment Investments 268,107' at September 30, 2025.
arithmetic: Rule value = college-held 209,743 only. The first researcher's 248,077 = 209,743 + 38,334, where 38,334 is the Foundation's opening balance at December 31, 2023 read from the FY2025 report. Roll-forward check: 38,334 + 225,000 + 3,625 + 5,259 - 484 = 271,734.
entity_note: The College (a component unit of the State of Alabama) for $209,743. Drake State Technical College Foundation, Inc. is not part of the FY2024 report; it first appears as a discretely presented component unit in the FY2025 report, with a December 31 year end.
differences_from_original: Value corrected from $248,077 to $209,743. The final rule allows institution-held and foundation endowment to be added only when both come from audited FY2024 documents. The $38,334 comes from the FY2025 report, where it is only the opening line of a roll-forward (no December 31, 2023 balance sheet is presented there), and it is dated nine months before the College's year end, so it is described rather than added.
reader_caveats: The College captions the asset 'Endowment Investments' but reports no restricted-nonexpendable net position, and the notes do not describe what the endowment investments are (they are not in the fair value table, which lists only U.S. Treasuries of $5,053,266). The Foundation's endowment grew to $271,734 by December 31, 2024 after a $225,000 contribution, which falls outside the FY2024 window. The Foundation's statements were not audited under Government Auditing Standards.

quotes: p.20, University column (2024): 'Lease liabilities - current portion 7,652,223'; 'Subcription liabilities - current portion 433,396'; 'Long-term lease liabilities 19,405,295'; 'Long-term subcription liabilities 557,302'; 'Other long-term liabilities 9,571'; 'Total Noncurrent Liabilities 19,972,168'; 'Total Liabilities 74,234,565' [spelling as printed]. No bonds payable, notes payable or loans line. p.52 Note 9(b): 'The University entered into contractual agreements as a lessee for building facilities, office machinery and equipment, and a ground lease. ... As of September 30, 2024, the lease liability totaled $27,057,518.' p.52 Note 10: 'As of September 30, 2024, the subscription liability totaled $990,698.' p.11 MD&A: 'The University does not have any debt related to its capital assets.' p.19 MD&A: 'the University has no separate long-term borrowing authority' and the capital plan is 'financed through funding sources provided by the District'.
arithmetic: Bonds 0 + notes 0 + financed purchases 0 = 0. Column check: printed current-liability lines sum to 54,262,397 and noncurrent to 19,972,168. Memo: GASB 87 lease liabilities 7,652,223 + 19,405,295 = 27,057,518; subscription liabilities 433,396 + 557,302 = 990,698 (shown in 'other').
entity_note: The University's own audited statements (a component unit of the Government of the District of Columbia). Its two foundations are discretely presented in a separate column.
reader_caveats: The University has no borrowing authority; its capital programme is paid for by District of Columbia capital appropriations, so any related bonds are District debt and none is allocated to the University in its statements. The two MD&A sentences quoted are unaudited; the absence of bonds and notes is on the audited statement of net position. The $27.1 million of lease liabilities are GASB 87 right-to-use leases (including a ground lease running to 2078) and are excluded by rule. The 2023 comparative column is labelled 'Restated'.
